title: 🎉 easystats wins a SIPS Mission Award
summary: The easystats collection of R packages has won a Mission Award from the Society for the Improvement of Psychological Science (SIPS).
content: The easystats collection of R packages has won a Mission Award from the Society for the Improvement of Psychological Science (SIPS).

easystats brings together a suite of R packages (including bayestestR, parameters, performance and others) designed to make statistical analysis and reporting more transparent, correct and easy to use. The award recognises its impact on how psychologists analyse and communicate their data.
Built and maintained with a large community of contributors, easystats keeps proving that better tools make for better science.
